description:
Create a Saved Search in the Complaints module to filter for high-priority cases. 

Goal: 
1. Log in to ArkCase (admin/ArkCase1234!).
2. Navigate to the Complaints module.
3. Create a search filter that shows ONLY cases with 'High' priority.
4. Save this search with the exact name: 'Urgent Safety Queue'.
5. Execute the saved search.
6. Create a text file at '/home/ga/urgent_cases.txt' and list the Case Numbers of all results found (one per line).
